paragraphs: R' Nasa, or Nisa, of Caesarea.
Mentioned in Esther Rabbah 2:9 and Lamentations Rabbah, petichta 26.[^1]

notes.text: נסא and ניסא are distinct supplied forms, Nasa or Nisa, with conventional vowels rather than two identical Nissa renderings. אס״ר פ״ב-ט is read as Esther Rabbah chapter 2 section 9; איכה רבתי בפתחתא-כו gives Lamentations Rabbah petichta 26. Neither is independently checked against a named edition. Older machine פ״ב״ט/חכו differ from supplied labels. The personal title remains R'.
